subject: Recap: pricing runway, sign-off path & pilot volume confirmation
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Patel <sana@finpay.co>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Recap: pricing runway, sign-off path & pilot volume confirmation

Hi Sana —

Great to speak this morning. Quick recap of what we covered and two asks to keep momentum: 1) confirm the short pilot ranges & 2) confirm who will sign/approve (procurement path vs CFO).

What I heard on the call:
- Pilot target: 50M–150M tokens/month (90-day pilot window)
- Long-run scale: potential to ramp to ~1B tokens/month within 9–12 months if initial KPIs hit
- Budget for pilot: internal range of $60k–$200k/month (you said this covers the initial 3 months)
- Key approvers: CFO Mike Rosen (final sign-off) + procurement team (PO + contracting)

Unit-econ examples (ballpark, before discounts/commitments):
- 75M tokens / month pilot @ $900 per 1M tokens => ~$67.5k/month
- 150M tokens / month pilot @ $850 per 1M tokens => ~$127.5k/month
- At scale (1B tokens/month) @ $750 per 1M tokens => ~$750k/month (committed pricing subject to 12-month SLA)

Attached: redwood-pricing-calc-v2.xlsx (breaks down model variants, batch/latency tradeoffs, and an entry for pilot vs committed bands). Also shared a draft mutual action plan in the Drive link.

Asks / next steps:
- Sana: can you confirm procurement PO owner (email) and whether CFO wants a formal one-pager before sign-off?
- Mike (if helpful): can we get an expected decision date for pilot approval?
- We’ll prepare a 1-page summary (cost + SLOs + security checklist) for Mike and procurement to accelerate review.

If this aligns, I’ll send a short pilot SOW + suggested pilot discount band (we suggested a small, time-boxed commitment to lower unit price for the pilot).

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D: 415-555-0123
From: Sana Patel <sana@finpay.co>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Rosen <mike.rosen@finpay.co>, procurement@finpay.co
Date: 2026-11-22T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap: pricing runway, sign-off path & pilot volume confirmation

Thanks, Dylan —

Appreciate the clear recap. Confirming a couple items from my side:
- Pilot budget: yes, target is $60k–$200k/month for the first 3 months. That covers the smaller initial user cohort.
- Scale plan: we are highly likely to scale to ~1B tokens/month in the next 6–12 months if signal-to-noise and latency meet our product goals.
- Approval path: CFO Mike Rosen will sign for anything >$100k/month. Procurement handles PO and standard contract templates.

Looping in Mike and procurement here — Mike, can you confirm whether you want a single-page cost summary or a short pricing addendum before you sign?

On procurement: procurement@finpay.co is our intake inbox. Please send SOW + pricing and we’ll route internally.

Sana
Product Lead, FinPay

On 2026-11-22 09:12, Dylan Brooks wrote:
> Great to speak this morning. Quick recap of what we covered and two asks to keep momentum: 1) confirm the short pilot ranges & 2) confirm who will sign/approve (procurement path vs CFO).
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Patel <sana@finpay.co>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Mike Rosen <mike.rosen@finpay.co>, procurement@finpay.co
Date: 2026-11-23T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap: pricing runway, sign-off path & pilot volume confirmation

Thanks for the quick response, Sana — and hi Mike / procurement.

To make the review easy, two concrete price bands we can propose for the pilot and scale:
- Time-boxed pilot (90 days): 50M–150M tokens/month -> $800–$950 per 1M tokens (example monthly spend ~$40k–$142.5k depending on exact volume and selected model).
- Committed scale (12-mo): 1B tokens/month -> ~ $700–$800 per 1M tokens (we’d ask for a commitment window to secure lower unit economics).

Examples to help budgeting:
- Pilot midpoint (100M tokens) at $900/1M => ~$90k/month.
- If you want to keep initial spend under $100k/month, target ~110M tokens at $900/1M or reduce to a smaller model profile.

Ask for procurement/CFO:
1) Which authorization path should we prepare for? (DocuSign + PO, or internal approval to proceed for pilot without PO?)
2) Target decision date for pilot (Sana suggested week of Nov 29; can we confirm exact day?)

I’ve attached the pricing calc and will prepare a one-page SOW + 1-pager for Mike that highlights SLOs, data handling, and acceptance criteria. If procurement prefers a template, we’ll slot pricing into that.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if useful.

Dylan

Looping in as well — quick internal note to align expectations.

We can offer the following to help close the pilot decision quickly: 
- Pilot-friendly band: capped price at $950 per 1M tokens for the 90-day pilot (50M–150M range) with opt-in for earlier conversion to committed pricing if FinPay elects to scale.
- Commitment incentive: 12-month commitment at 1B tokens/month -> target $750 per 1M tokens (final number will be in the SOW).
- We will produce a 1-page cost & security summary for Mike (aiming to keep it under 1 page) and a short contractor-friendly SOW for procurement.

Vanessa will join the procurement call and I’ll be available next Tue/Thu mornings PST for a 15-min handoff.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
